questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 Consider a scenario where you have a dataset with overlapping classes (that is instances from different classes share similar or identical feature values), and you decide to train a perceptron model for classification. Reason (R): The perceptron learning algorithm aims to find a linear decision boundary that separates the classes, and in the presence of overlapping classes, it may not be able to capture the underlying patterns effectively. Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
